titulo.alumno: Telling someone by message what you did over the weekend

intro: In this lesson you will practice telling someone by message what you did over the weekend.

texto: Adjust the greeting and sign-off to the recipient; make the reason clear and the information you need to confirm.

frases.estudio: Το Σαββατοκύριακο πήγαμε στη θάλασσα, φάγαμε με φίλους και ξεκουραστήκαμε.
frases.alumno: On the weekend we went to the sea, ate with friends and rested.

frases.estudio: Σας γράφω για να κλείσω ένα δωμάτιο από τις 10 έως τις 13 Αυγούστου.
frases.alumno: I'm writing to reserve a room from the 10th to the 13th of August.

frases.estudio: Σε ευχαριστώ για τη βοήθεια και για τον χρόνο που μου αφιέρωσες.
frases.alumno: Thank you for your help and for the time you gave me.

pregunta.texto: Listen to the request and locate which reservation or detail is to be confirmed.

piezas.explicacion: Check that the message includes a concrete detail, keeps the time or logical order and ends appropriately.
